Detailed diagram of a single nephron with its blood supply, arranged vertically with a dashed line marking the boundary between cortex (top) and medulla (bottom). Show the cup-shaped Bowman's capsule enclosing a red glomerulus; a wide afferent arteriole entering and a narrower efferent arteriole leaving; the proximal convoluted tubule coiling in the cortex; the loop of Henle dipping into the medulla with descending and ascending limbs; the distal convoluted tubule back in the cortex; and the collecting duct running down into the medulla towards the pelvis. A network of capillaries surrounds the tubules and joins into a blue branch of the renal vein.
